All nine name variants resolve to one and the same legal entity, renamed: Climan Properties Pvt Ltd (inc. 19.09.1994) -> Climan Properties Ltd (17.04.2000) -> Encon Technologies Ltd (19.04.2000) -> Lloyds Encon Technologies (I) Ltd (31.05.2011) -> Lloyds Steels Industries Ltd (04.05.2013) -> Lloyds Engineering Works Ltd (fresh CoI 25.07.2023, RoC Mumbai). Source: https://www.lloydsengg.in/about-us/history/ . Engineering division demerged from Uttam Value Steels Ltd into the company per Bombay High Court order 30.10.2015 (speaking-to-minutes 30.11.2015); listed BSE/NSE 18.07.2016. So 'Lloyds Steels Industries Limited' is a former name, not a separate live supplier - no duplicate risk entries needed.
